Hi Ken / Priya -

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of requirements from call:
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 300ms for streaming text generation, p50 < 120ms for non-streaming generation.
- Throughput: target sustained 120 requests/sec, bursts to 350 rps for 10-15s.
- Concurrency: up to 300 concurrent client streams.
- Streaming: server-side streaming required for chat playback; chunked tokens every ~150ms.

Proposed next steps (customer-led load test):
1) You run customer-led tests using k6/Locust against our sandbox endpoint (we'll provide test accounts + allowlist).
2) We'll staff an on-call engineer (Aditya) during the window to monitor and collect logs / traces.
3) If we observe regressions, we'll triage with you immediately and propose mitigations (scaling, config tweaks, fallback model).

Can you confirm the following so we can schedule:
- Preferred test window (date + timezone)
- Which tool you'll use (k6 or Locust) and whether you need our sample scripts
- IP ranges to add to the allowlist

I attached a short loadtest plan and a sample k6 script (k6_script_v1.js) - feel free to use or adapt.

Thanks - I'll loop in Aditya and Rishi for engineering coverage.
—
Marissa Cole
